status: provisional geometry and control experiment; not hardware specifications
notes: Alpha: fixed front shoulder mount; no sleeve, extra swivel, or arm-assisted mobility.
All dimensions and actuator limits are assumptions. No hardware selected.
Finger commands synchronized; physical coupling undecided.

Provisional design revision: 650 g lumped inner body with rearward COM to balance the folded front arm. This is an assumed battery/electronics mass distribution, not a measured or selected hardware pack.
Wheel control uses bounded total-torque state feedback. Gains are provisional simulation values; wheel motor electrical dynamics are not modeled.

Dynamic empty-arm validation: slow synchronized joint-space paths (0.08 rad/s maximum main-joint target rate) and a 0.30 rad quasi-static lean guard. Geometry-only forward/lower poses exceed this guard. arm_reach is a compact raised reach, not full forward extension.

Alpha self-collision enabled after the initial empty-arm milestone. Added a 15 mm wrist-to-palm standoff and reduced empty-claw closure to avoid forearm/finger and fingertip overlap. Lumped palm mass includes the standoff; real component masses remain unknown.
24 October user revision: two opposing curling fingers replace three radial fingers. Earlier three-finger grasp results are archived and do not transfer. Claw roll starts in Beta and remains in X.

Two-finger balance revision: body COM moved from -31.665 to -28.887 mm in the provisional layout to center the folded configuration. Body mass, joint/wheel caps and gains unchanged; total modeled mass falls by 16 g to 1.207 kg. Needs real component layout.
gripper_design: Two opposing jointed curling fingers on palm-local +/-Y; left/right pinch in reference grasp posture

wrist_roll_plan.axis: Claw/palm local Z, along wrist-to-claw approach axis
wrist_roll_plan.implementation: Deferred to Beta; absent in Alpha
